defect.description: The parent contract already reserves maximum possible occupancy for placebo templates, but its eligible-anchor rule says only that original candidate signal/exposure intervals are excluded. For a dynamic-exit candidate, interpreting that source-side exclusion with realized early-exit duration would let post-entry path information change the placebo anchor pool. This amendment removes that source-exclusion degree of freedom before any Stage-1 or baseline outcome is opened, without changing Stage-1 source-cluster identity or count.

normative_rules.anchor_overlap_rule: A randomized-timing placebo anchor is ineligible if its reserved maximum-exposure interval overlaps any source candidate reserved maximum-exposure interval in the same training partition or frozen validation half. Apply the same interval convention to both source and placebo sides.
normative_rules.cluster_concurrency: When a source independent-event cluster contains multiple constituents, reserve the union of all constituent maximum-occupancy intervals before selecting any placebo anchor.
normative_rules.fixed_hold_candidates: For fixed-hold candidates, maximum possible occupancy equals the already-frozen fixed holding interval; there is no realized-exit shortening.
normative_rules.insufficient_pool: If this stricter outcome-blind source reservation makes the deterministic placebo pool insufficient, return DATA/PIT_INCONCLUSIVE_RANDOMIZED_PLACEBO_POOL. Do not fall back to realized-exit exclusions, shrink the source set, redraw, relax partition/half containment, or reuse overlapping anchors.
normative_rules.range_auction_candidate: For DISC-RANGE-AUCTION-REV-001-v1, freeze the source reserved interval from the original signal's t+1 entry open through the t+7 open corresponding to the frozen six-hour maximum hold, regardless of whether the realized path would trigger midpoint take-profit or ATR stop earlier.
normative_rules.source_cluster_identity: Keep the parent contract's source-unit identity and source independent-event count exactly as frozen from the scored Stage-1 schedule; this amendment does not change candidate Stage-1 scoring, trade scheduling, non-overlap, or clustering.
normative_rules.source_exclusion_interval_formation: Only for excluding original candidate signal/exposure intervals from the randomized placebo eligible-anchor pool, reserve each source constituent's maximum possible exposure occupancy implied by the frozen candidate rules. Do not shorten that exclusion with realized stop/take-profit timing, realized early exits, realized P&L, or other post-entry path information.
